title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-31
lineage: SBD > Reel Master > 2 cassette generations > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a high‑octane NYE ’69 show with smoking Mason’s Children, Alligator and Big Boy Pete, though some cassette hiss makes it less than pristine.
ai_review.review: The Boston Tea Party New Year's Eve concert is praised for its high energy, tight playing and standout jams like Mason’s Children, Alligator and Big Boy Pete.  The SBD source is generally clear and well‑balanced, but reviewers note a few generations of cassette copies that add hiss and a slightly distant feel, plus occasional mix quirks (Weir’s guitar low).

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight strong performance; recording is good but not immaculate, yielding a weighted rating around 4.3–4.5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear mix with good vocals; some reviewers mention cassette‑generation hiss and distant sound, plus occasional balance issues (Weir’s guitar low in the mix).

show_quality.setlist_flow: A lighter, straight‑up NYE set that blends early‑’69 material with a few newer numbers, maintaining a strong forward momentum and plenty of jam space.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his magnificent tone and emotional playing; many note his “bad‑ass” guitar work throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted in trading duels with Jerry, delivering powerful bass moments that stand out as some of their best.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for solid rhythm chords under the jam sections, especially on Alligator.
